sources.entry: iRedMail - Full-featured mail server solution based on Postfix and Dovecot. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Shell

summary.one_liner: iRedMail is a full-featured mail server solution built on Postfix and Dovecot, with installation support for several Linux and BSD distributions.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes iRedMail as a full-featured mail server solution based on Postfix and Dovecot (per the awesome-selfhosted listing). It lists supported platforms: CentOS Stream 9 and 10, Rocky Linux 9 and 10, AlmaLinux 9 and 10, Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04, FreeBSD 14.x, and OpenBSD 7.8. Installation is done by following the project's installation guides. The README also points to a paid "iRedMail Easy" platform offering one-click upgrades and ticket-based support, and to an all-in-one Docker edition in a separate repository. Community support is through an online forum, and paid support services are offered. Source packages patched for RHEL/CentOS are linked from the README, while other RPMs come from the official yum repository and EPEL.
use_cases: set up a self-hosted mail server for a domain
run company or team email on your own server
deploy Postfix and Dovecot mail stack quickly
host email on Debian or Ubuntu
host email on Rocky or AlmaLinux
how_to_run: Check the supported OS list in the README and pick a supported distribution.
Download the latest stable release from the iRedMail website.
Follow the official installation guides strictly.
Optionally use the all-in-one Docker edition (iredmail/dockerized) instead.
notable: Built on Postfix and Dovecot as a complete mail server bundle
Supports multiple Linux distributions and FreeBSD and OpenBSD
Official Docker edition available in a separate repository
Paid iRedMail Easy platform for one-click upgrades and ticket support
Source packages patched for RHEL/CentOS are provided
caveats: Installation must follow the official guides closely; it is not a one-click app
Some advanced features and one-click upgrades are tied to the paid iRedMail Easy platform
Paid support services are offered; community support is via forum
keywords: team email on my own server
